response.courseDescription: 407 Student Teaching in Agricultural Education Supervised teaching in public schools including seminars reflecting effective teaching. Required preparation: Includes applying; paying certification fees; completing all other coursework for degree and teacher certification; receiving fingerprint clearance from WSP, FBI, and Office of Professional Practices; maintaining 2.5 GPA overall and in endorsement and professional core classes. Placement by interview only. S, F grading.
response.coursePrerequisites: AG ED 440; AG ED 450; AG ED 471; senior standing.
